require "json"
require "http/server"
require "option_parser"
require "log"
require "digest/sha256"
require "file_utils"
require "yaml"
require "random/secure"
require "time"

module JAIDE
  class DataWorker
    property log : Log
    property config : Hash(String, YAML::Any)
    property queue : Channel(Tuple(String, String))
    property metrics : Hash(String, Float64)
    property metrics_mutex : Mutex
    property trajectory : Array(Array(Float64))
    property xs : Array(Float64)
    property basis_precomputed : Array(Array(Float64))
    property basis_sums : Array(Float64)
    property cos_vals : Array(Float64)
    property sin_vals : Array(Float64)
    property stop_channel : Channel(Nil)?
    property server : HTTP::Server?

    def initialize(config_path : String)
      @log = Log.for(self.class.name)
      unless File.exists?(config_path)
        raise ArgumentError.new("Config file not found: #{config_path}")
      end
      begin
        @config = YAML.parse(File.read(config_path)).as_h
      rescue ex : YAML::ParseException
        raise ArgumentError.new("Invalid YAML configuration: #{ex.message}")
      end
      queue_size = (@config["queue_size"]?.try(&.as_i) || 1000_i64).to_i
      @queue = Channel(Tuple(String, String)).new(queue_size)
      @metrics = {"processed" => 0.0, "errors" => 0.0, "avg_time" => 0.0}
      @metrics_mutex = Mutex.new
      @trajectory = compute_trajectory
      @xs = @trajectory.map(&.[0]).sort.uniq
      min_knots = 4
      if @xs.size < min_knots
        error_msg = "Not enough unique knots for a cubic B-spline. Requires at least #{min_knots}, but got #{@xs.size}."
        raise "B-spline initialization error: #{error_msg}"
      end
      span = @xs.last - @xs.first
      if span <= 0.0
        error_msg = "Invalid knot span for B-spline. Non-increasing knots."
        raise "B-spline initialization error: #{error_msg}"
      end
      @basis_precomputed = (0..74).map do |i|
        x = @xs.first + span * (i.to_f / 75.0)
        b_spline_basis(x, @xs, 3)
      end
      @basis_sums = @basis_precomputed.map(&.sum)
      dim = (@config["embedding_dimension"]?.try(&.as_i) || 18432_i64).to_i
      if dim <= 0
        dim = 18432
      end
      @cos_vals = Array(Float64).new(dim) { |i| Math.cos(2.0 * Math::PI * i.to_f / dim.to_f) }
      @sin_vals = Array(Float64).new(dim) { |i| Math.sin(2.0 * Math::PI * i.to_f / dim.to_f) }
      @stop_channel = nil
      @server = nil
    end

    def compute_trajectory : Array(Array(Float64))
      lorenz_config = @config["lorenz"]?.try(&.as_h) || {} of String => YAML::Any
      sigma = lorenz_config["sigma"]?.try(&.as_f) || 10.0
      rho = lorenz_config["rho"]?.try(&.as_f) || 28.0
      beta = lorenz_config["beta"]?.try(&.as_f) || (8.0 / 3.0)
      dt = lorenz_config["dt"]?.try(&.as_f) || 0.01
      steps = (lorenz_config["steps"]?.try(&.as_i) || 1000_i64).to_i
      x0 = lorenz_config["x0"]?.try(&.as_f) || 0.1
      y0 = lorenz_config["y0"]?.try(&.as_f) || 1.0
      z0 = lorenz_config["z0"]?.try(&.as_f) || 1.05
      traj = Array(Array(Float64)).new(capacity: steps)
      x = x0
      y = y0
      z = z0
      steps.times do
        dx = sigma * (y - x)
        dy = x * (rho - z) - y
        dz = x * y - beta * z
        x += dt * dx
        y += dt * dy
        z += dt * dz
        traj << [x, y, z]
      end
      traj
    end

    def start
      threads_cfg = (@config["num_threads"]?.try(&.as_i) || 4_i64).to_i
      @log.info { "DataWorker starting with #{threads_cfg} threads" }
      stop_channel = Channel(Nil).new
      @stop_channel = stop_channel
      spawn_http_server
      spawn_processor
      spawn_metrics_reporter(stop_channel)
      Signal::INT.trap { stop }
      Signal::TERM.trap { stop }
      @log.info { "DataWorker started. Press Ctrl+C to shut down." }
      stop_channel.receive
      @log.info { "Main fiber exiting." }
    end

    def stop
      @log.info { "Shutting down DataWorker..." }
      @server.try(&.close)
      @queue.close
      @stop_channel.try(&.send(nil))
    end

    def spawn_http_server
      server_config = @config["server"]?.try(&.as_h) || {} of String => YAML::Any
      address = server_config["host"]?.try(&.as_s) || "127.0.0.1"
      port = (server_config["port"]?.try(&.as_i) || 8080_i64).to_i
      server = HTTP::Server.new do |context|
        begin
          if context.request.method == "POST" && context.request.path == "/ingest"
            body = context.request.body.try(&.gets_to_end) || ""
            if body.empty?
              context.response.status_code = 400
              context.response.content_type = "application/json"
              context.response.print({error: "Empty request body"}.to_json)
              next
            end
            json_data = JSON.parse(body)
            data_hash = json_data.as_h
            id = data_hash["id"]?.try(&.as_s)
            content = data_hash["content"]?.try(&.as_s)
            if id && content
              @queue.send({id, content})
              context.response.status_code = 200
              context.response.content_type = "application/json"
              context.response.print({status: "ingested"}.to_json)
            else
              context.response.status_code = 400
              context.response.content_type = "application/json"
              context.response.print({error: "Missing id or content in payload"}.to_json)
            end
          else
            context.response.status_code = 404
            context.response.content_type = "application/json"
            context.response.print({error: "Endpoint not found"}.to_json)
          end
        rescue ex : JSON::ParseException
          context.response.status_code = 400
          context.response.content_type = "application/json"
          context.response.print({error: "Invalid JSON format"}.to_json)
        rescue ex
          context.response.status_code = 500
          context.response.content_type = "application/json"
          context.response.print({error: "Internal server error: #{ex.message}"}.to_json)
        end
      end
      @server = server
      begin
        server.bind_tcp address, port
      rescue ex : IO::Error
        @log.fatal { "Failed to bind to #{address}:#{port}: #{ex.message}" }
        stop
        return
      end
      spawn do
        begin
          server.listen
        rescue ex : IO::Error
          @log.info { "HTTP server shut down." }
        rescue ex
          @log.error { "HTTP server error: #{ex}" }
        end
      end
    end

    def spawn_processor
      threads = (@config["num_threads"]?.try(&.as_i) || 4_i64).to_i
      threads.times do
        spawn do
          loop do
            begin
              id, content = @queue.receive
              start_time = Time.monotonic
              success = false
              begin
                process_data(id, content)
                success = true
              rescue ex
                @log.error { "Error processing #{id}: #{ex}" }
              ensure
                duration = Time.monotonic - start_time
                duration_ms = duration.total_milliseconds
                @metrics_mutex.synchronize do
                  prev_total = @metrics["processed"] + @metrics["errors"]
                  if success
                    @metrics["processed"] += 1.0
                  else
                    @metrics["errors"] += 1.0
                  end
                  new_total = @metrics["processed"] + @metrics["errors"]
                  if prev_total > 0
                    @metrics["avg_time"] = ((@metrics["avg_time"] * prev_total) + duration_ms) / new_total
                  else
                    @metrics["avg_time"] = duration_ms
                  end
                end
              end
            rescue ex : Channel::ClosedError
              @log.info { "Processor shutting down." }
              break
            rescue ex
              @log.error { "Processor thread error: #{ex}" }
              break
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    def process_data(id : String, content : String) : String
      tokens = tokenize(content)
      embeds = embed_lorenz(tokens)
      normalized = normalize(embeds)
      byte_count = normalized.size * sizeof(Float64)
      bytes = normalized.to_unsafe.as(UInt8*).to_slice(byte_count)
      hash = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(bytes)
      server_config = @config["server"]?.try(&.as_h) || {} of String => YAML::Any
      out_dir = server_config["output_dir"]?.try(&.as_s) || "./output"
      unless File.directory?(out_dir)
        FileUtils.mkdir_p(out_dir)
      end
      temp_path = "#{out_dir}/#{id}.json.tmp.#{Random::Secure.hex(8)}"
      final_path = "#{out_dir}/#{id}.json"
      begin
        File.open(temp_path, "w") do |file|
          JSON.build(file) do |json|
            json.object do
              json.field "hash", hash
              json.field "tokens" do
                json.array { tokens.each { |t| json.number t } }
              end
              json.field "embeds" do
                json.array { normalized.each { |e| json.number e } }
              end
            end
          end
        end
        File.rename(temp_path, final_path)
      rescue ex : IO::Error
        File.delete(temp_path) if File.exists?(temp_path)
        raise
      rescue ex
        File.delete(temp_path) if File.exists?(temp_path)
        raise
      end
      hash
    end

    def tokenize(content : String) : Array(Int32)
      content.chars.map { |c| c.ord % 75 }
    end

    def embed_lorenz(tokens : Array(Int32)) : Array(Float64)
      dim = @cos_vals.size
      embeds = Array(Float64).new(tokens.size * dim, 0.0)
      index = 0
      tokens.each_with_index do |tid, t|
        norm_tid = tid.to_f / 75.0
        traj_idx = t % @trajectory.size
        traj_pt = @trajectory[traj_idx]
        basis_sum = @basis_sums[tid]
        spline_wt = traj_pt[1] * basis_sum
        d = 0
        while d < dim
          mod_x = traj_pt[0] * @cos_vals[d] + traj_pt[2] * @sin_vals[d]
          embeds[index] = norm_tid * mod_x * spline_wt
          index += 1
          d += 1
        end
      end
      embeds
    end

    def b_spline_basis(x : Float64, knots : Array(Float64), degree : Int32) : Array(Float64)
      if knots.size < degree + 1
        raise ArgumentError.new("Not enough knots for given degree")
      end
      n_knots = knots.size
      if degree == 0
        basis = Array(Float64).new(n_knots - 1, 0.0)
        i = 0
        while i < (n_knots - 1)
          if (knots[i] <= x && x < knots[i + 1]) || (i == n_knots - 2 && x == knots.last)
            basis[i] = 1.0
          end
          i += 1
        end
        return basis
      end
      basis_len = n_knots - degree - 1
      basis = Array(Float64).new(basis_len, 0.0)
      sub = b_spline_basis(x, knots, degree - 1)
      i = 0
      while i < basis.size
        left_denom = knots[i + degree] - knots[i]
        right_denom = knots[i + degree + 1] - knots[i + 1]
        left_num = left_denom != 0.0 ? (x - knots[i]) / left_denom : 0.0
        right_num = right_denom != 0.0 ? (knots[i + degree + 1] - x) / right_denom : 0.0
        left_val = i < sub.size ? sub[i] : 0.0
        right_val = (i + 1) < sub.size ? sub[i + 1] : 0.0
        basis[i] = left_num * left_val + right_num * right_val
        i += 1
      end
      basis
    end

    def normalize(embeds : Array(Float64)) : Array(Float64)
      return [] of Float64 if embeds.empty?
      count = 0
      mean = 0.0
      m2 = 0.0
      embeds.each do |x|
        count += 1
        delta = x - mean
        mean += delta / count
        delta2 = x - mean
        m2 += delta * delta2
      end
      return Array(Float64).new(embeds.size, 0.0) if count < 2
      variance = m2 / count
      std_dev = Math.sqrt(variance)
      if std_dev > 0.0
        embeds.map { |e| (e - mean) / std_dev }
      else
        Array(Float64).new(embeds.size, 0.0)
      end
    end

    def spawn_metrics_reporter(stop_chan : Channel(Nil))
      spawn do
        loop do
          begin
            select
            when stop_chan.receive
              @log.info { "Metrics reporter shutting down." }
              break
            when timeout(10.seconds)
              snapshot = {} of String => Float64
              @metrics_mutex.synchronize do
                snapshot["processed"] = @metrics["processed"]
                snapshot["errors"] = @metrics["errors"]
                snapshot["avg_time"] = @metrics["avg_time"]
              end
              @log.info { "Metrics: processed=#{snapshot["processed"].to_i}, errors=#{snapshot["errors"].to_i}, avg_time=#{snapshot["avg_time"].round(2)}ms" }
            end
          rescue ex
            @log.error { "Metrics reporter error: #{ex}" }
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

config_path = ""

LF term : type =
  | true : term
  | false : term
  | if_then_else : term → term → term → term
  | z : term
  | succ : term → term
  | pred : term → term
  | iszero : term → term;

LF value : term → type =
  | v_zero : value z
  | v_succ : value V → value (succ V)
  | v_true : value true
  | v_false : value false;

LF step : term → term → type =
  | e_if_true : step (if_then_else true M2 M3) M2
  | e_if_false : step (if_then_else false M2 M3) M3
  | e_pred_zero : step (pred z) z
  | e_pred_succ : value V → step (pred (succ V)) V
  | e_iszero_zero : step (iszero z) true
  | e_iszero_succ : value V → step (iszero (succ V)) false
  | e_if_then_else : step M1 M1’ → step (if_then_else M1 M2 M3) (if_then_else M1’ M2 M3)
  | e_succ : step M N → step (succ M) (succ N)
  | e_pred : step M N → step (pred M) (pred N)
  | e_iszero : step M N → step (iszero M) (iszero N);

let e1 : [ ` step (pred (succ (pred z))) (pred (succ z))] =
  [ ` e_pred (e_succ e_pred_zero)];

let e2 : [ ` step (pred (succ z)) z] =
  [ ` e_pred_succ v_zero];

LF tp : type =
  | bool : tp
  | nat : tp;

LF hastype : term → tp → type =
  | t_true : hastype true bool
  | t_false : hastype false bool
  | t_zero : hastype z nat
  | t_if : hastype M1 bool → hastype M2 T → hastype M3 T → hastype (if_then_else M1 M2 M3) T
  | t_succ : hastype M nat → hastype (succ M) nat
  | t_pred : hastype M nat → hastype (pred M) nat
  | t_iszero : hastype M nat → hastype (iszero M) bool;

rec tps: [ ` hastype M T] → [ ` step M N] → [ ` hastype N T] =
  / total s (tps m t n d s) /
  fn d ⇒ fn s ⇒
  case s of
  | [ ` e_if_true] ⇒ let [ ` t_if_then_else D D1 D2] = d in [ ` D1]
  | [ ` e_if_false] ⇒ let [ ` t_if_then_else D D1 D2] = d in [ ` D2]
  | [ ` e_if_then_else S] ⇒ let [ ` t_if_then_else D D1 D2] = d in let [ ` D’] = tps [ ` D] [ ` S] in [ ` t_if_then_else D’ D1 D2]
  | [ ` e_pred_zero] ⇒ let [ ` t_pred _ ] = d in [ ` t_zero]
  | [ ` e_pred_succ _ ] ⇒ let [ ` t_pred (t_succ D) ] = d in [ ` D]
  | [ ` e_iszero_zero] ⇒ let [ ` t_iszero _] = d in [ ` t_true]
  | [ ` e_iszero_succ _ ] ⇒ let [ ` t_iszero _] = d in [ ` t_false]
  | [ ` e_pred S] ⇒ let [ ` t_pred D] = d in let [ ` D’] = tps [ ` D] [ ` S] in [ ` t_pred D’]
  | [ ` e_succ S] ⇒ let [ ` t_succ D] = d in let [ ` D’] = tps [ ` D] [ ` S] in [ ` t_succ D’]
  | [ ` e_iszero S] ⇒ let [ ` t_iszero D] = d in let [ ` D’] = tps [ ` D] [ ` S] in [ ` t_iszero D’];

LF not_possible: type.

rec values_dont_step : [ ` step M N] → [ ` value M] → [ ` not_possible] =
  / total v (values_dont_step m m’ s v) /
  fn s ⇒ fn v ⇒
  case v of
  | [ ` v_true] ⇒ impossible s
  | [ ` v_false] ⇒ impossible s
  | [ ` v_z ] ⇒ impossible s
  | [ ` v_s V’] ⇒ let [ ` e_succ S’] = s in values_dont_step [ ` S’] [ ` V’];

LF equal: term → term → type =
  | ref: equal T T;

rec unique : [ ` step M M1] → [ ` step M M2] → [ ` equal M1 M2] =
  / total s (unique m m1 m2 s)/
  fn s1 ⇒ fn s2 ⇒
  case s1 of
  | [ ` e_if_true] ⇒ (
      case s2 of
      | [ ` e_if_true] ⇒ [ ` ref]
      | [ ` e_if_then_else D] ⇒ impossible values_dont_step [ ` D] [ ` v_true]
    )
  | [ ` e_if_false] ⇒ (
      case s2 of
      | [ ` e_if_false] ⇒ [ ` ref]
      | [ ` e_if_then_else D] ⇒ impossible values_dont_step [ ` D] [ ` v_false]
    )
  | [ ` e_if_then_else D] ⇒ (
      case s2 of
      | [ ` e_if_true] ⇒ impossible values_dont_step [ ` D] [ ` v_true]
      | [ ` e_if_false] ⇒ impossible values_dont_step [ ` D] [ ` v_false]
      | [ ` e_if_then_else E] ⇒ let [ ` ref] = unique [ ` D] [ ` E] in [ ` ref]
    )
  | [ ` e_succ D] ⇒ (
      case s2 of
      | [ ` e_succ E] ⇒ let [ ` ref] = unique [ ` D] [ ` E] in [ ` ref]
      | _ ⇒ impossible s2
    )
  | [ ` e_pred_zero] ⇒ (
      case s2 of
      | [ ` e_pred_zero] ⇒ [ ` ref]
      | [ ` e_pred D] ⇒ impossible values_dont_step [ ` D] [ ` v_zero]
    )
  | [ ` e_pred_succ V] ⇒ (
      case s2 of
      | [ ` e_pred_succ V’] ⇒ [ ` ref]
      | [ ` e_pred D] ⇒ impossible values_dont_step [ ` D] [ ` v_succ V’]
    )
  | [ ` e_pred D] ⇒ (
      case s2 of
      | [ ` e_pred_zero] ⇒ impossible values_dont_step [ ` D] [ ` v_zero]
      | [ ` e_pred_succ V] ⇒ impossible values_dont_step [ ` D] [ ` v_succ V]
      | [ ` e_pred E] ⇒ let [ ` ref] = unique [ ` D] [ ` E] in [ ` ref]
    )
  | [ ` e_iszero_zero] ⇒ (
      case s2 of
      | [ ` e_iszero_zero] ⇒ [ ` ref]
      | [ ` e_iszero D] ⇒ impossible values_dont_step [ ` D] [ ` v_zero]
    )
  | [ ` e_iszero_succ V] ⇒ (
      case s2 of
      | [ ` e_iszero_succ V’] ⇒ [ ` ref]
      | [ ` e_iszero D] ⇒ impossible values_dont_step [ ` D] [ ` v_succ V’]
    )
  | [ ` e_iszero D] ⇒ (
      case s2 of
      | [ ` e_iszero_zero] ⇒ impossible values_dont_step [ ` D] [ ` v_zero]
      | [ ` e_iszero_succ V] ⇒ impossible values_dont_step [ ` D] [ ` v_succ V]
      | [ ` e_iszero E] ⇒ let [ ` ref] = unique [ ` D] [ ` E] in [ ` ref]
    );

LF multi_step : term → term → type =
  | ms_ref : multi_step M M
  | ms_step : step M M’ → multi_step M M’
  | ms_tr : multi_step M N → multi_step N M’ → multi_step M M’;

rec mstep_if_then_else : [ ` multi_step M M’] → {M1:[ ` term]}{M2:[ ` term]} [ ` multi_step (if_then_else M M1 M2) (if_then_else M’ M1 M2)] =
  / total ms (mstep_if_then_else _ _ ms)/
  fn ms ⇒
  case ms of
  | [ ` ms_ref] ⇒ mlam M1 ⇒ mlam M2 ⇒ [ ` ms_ref]
  | [ ` ms_step S] ⇒ mlam M1 ⇒ mlam M2 ⇒ [ ` ms_step (e_if_then_else S)]
  | [ ` ms_tr S1 S2] ⇒ mlam M1 ⇒ mlam M2 ⇒
      let [ ` S1’] = mstep_if_then_else [ ` S1] [ ` M1 ] [ ` M2 ] in
      let [ ` S2’] = mstep_if_then_else [ ` S2] [ ` M1 ] [ ` M2 ] in
      [ ` ms_tr S1’ S2’];

rec mstep_succ : [ ` multi_step M M’] → [ ` multi_step (succ M) (succ M’)] =
  / total ms (mstep_succ ms)/
  fn ms ⇒
  case ms of
  | [ ` ms_ref] ⇒ [ ` ms_ref]
  | [ ` ms_step S] ⇒ [ ` ms_step (e_succ S)]
  | [ ` ms_tr S1 S2] ⇒ [ ` ms_tr (mstep_succ S1) (mstep_succ S2)];

rec mstep_pred : [ ` multi_step M M’] → [ ` multi_step (pred M) (pred M’)] =
  / total ms (mstep_pred ms)/
  fn ms ⇒
  case ms of
  | [ ` ms_ref] ⇒ [ ` ms_ref]
  | [ ` ms_step S] ⇒ [ ` ms_step (e_pred S)]
  | [ ` ms_tr S1 S2] ⇒ [ ` ms_tr (mstep_pred S1) (mstep_pred S2)];

rec mstep_iszero : [ ` multi_step M M’] → [ ` multi_step (iszero M) (iszero M’)] =
  / total ms (mstep_iszero ms)/
  fn ms ⇒
  case ms of
  | [ ` ms_ref] ⇒ [ ` ms_ref]
  | [ ` ms_step S] ⇒ [ ` ms_step (e_iszero S)]
  | [ ` ms_tr S1 S2] ⇒ [ ` ms_tr (mstep_iszero S1) (mstep_iszero S2)];

LF halts: term → type =
  | result: multi_step M V → value V → halts M;

rec terminate : [ ` hastype M T] → [ ` halts M] =
  / total d (terminate m t d)/
  fn d ⇒
  case d of
  | [ ` t_true] ⇒ [ ` result ms_ref v_true]
  | [ ` t_false] ⇒ [ ` result ms_ref v_false]
  | [ ` t_if_then_else D D1 D2] ⇒
      let [ ` result MS V] = terminate [ ` D ] in
      let [ ` MS’] = mstep_if_then_else [ ` MS] [ ` _ ] [ ` _ ] in
      ( case V of
        | [ ` v_true] ⇒ let [ ` result MS1 V1] = terminate [ ` D1 ] in
            [ ` result (ms_tr MS’ (ms_tr (ms_step e_if_true) MS1)) V1]
        | [ ` v_false] ⇒ let [ ` result MS3 V3] = terminate [ ` D2 ] in
            [ ` result (ms_tr MS’ (ms_tr (ms_step e_if_false) MS3)) V3]
        | [ ` v_zero] ⇒ impossible multi_tps [ ` D] [ ` MS]
        | [ ` v_succ V’] ⇒ impossible multi_tps [ ` D] [ ` MS]
      )
  | [ ` t_zero] ⇒ [ ` result ms_ref v_zero]
  | [ ` t_succ D] ⇒
      let [ ` result MS V] = terminate [ ` D ] in
      let [ ` MS’] = mstep_succ [ ` MS] in
      ( case V of
        | [ ` v_zero] ⇒ [ ` result MS’ (v_succ v_zero)]
        | [ ` v_succ V’] ⇒ [ ` result MS’ (v_succ (v_succ V’))]
        | [ ` v_true] ⇒ impossible multi_tps [ ` D] [ ` MS]
        | [ ` v_false] ⇒ impossible multi_tps [ ` D] [ ` MS]
      )
  | [ ` t_pred D] ⇒
      let [ ` result MS V] = terminate [ ` D ] in
      let [ ` MS’] = mstep_pred [ ` MS] in
      ( case V of
        | [ ` v_zero] ⇒ [ ` result (ms_tr MS’ (ms_step e_pred_zero)) v_zero]
        | [ ` v_succ V’] ⇒ [ ` result (ms_tr MS’ (ms_step (e_pred_succ V’))) V’]
        | [ ` v_true] ⇒ impossible multi_tps [ ` D] [ ` MS]
        | [ ` v_false] ⇒ impossible multi_tps [ ` D] [ ` MS]
      )
  | [ ` t_iszero D] ⇒
      let [ ` result MS V] = terminate [ ` D ] in
      let [ ` MS’] = mstep_iszero [ ` MS] in
      ( case V of
        | [ ` v_zero] ⇒ [ ` result (ms_tr MS’ (ms_step e_iszero_zero)) v_true]
        | [ ` v_succ V’] ⇒ [ ` result (ms_tr MS’ (ms_step (e_iszero_succ V’))) v_false]
        | [ ` v_true] ⇒ impossible multi_tps [ ` D] [ ` MS]
        | [ ` v_false] ⇒ impossible multi_tps [ ` D] [ ` MS]
      );

LF bigstep : term → term → type =
  | b_value : value V → bigstep V V
  | b_succ : bigstep M V → bigstep (succ M) (succ V)
  | b_pred_zero : bigstep M z → bigstep (pred M) z
  | b_pred_succ : bigstep M (succ V) → bigstep (pred M) V
  | b_iszero_zero : bigstep M z → bigstep (iszero M) true
  | b_iszero_succ : bigstep M (succ V) → bigstep (iszero M) false
  | b_if_true : bigstep M1 true → bigstep M2 V → bigstep (if_then_else M1 M2 M3) V
  | b_if_false : bigstep M1 false → bigstep M3 V → bigstep (if_then_else M1 M2 M3) V;

rec bstep_value : [ ` bigstep M V] → [ ` value V] =
  / total b (bstep_value _ _ b) /
  fn b ⇒
  case b of
  | [ ` b_value E] ⇒ [ ` E]
  | [ ` b_succ B] ⇒ let [ ` E] = bstep_value [ ` B] in [ ` v_succ E]
  | [ ` b_pred_zero B] ⇒ bstep_value [ ` B]
  | [ ` b_pred_succ B] ⇒ let [ ` v_succ E] = bstep_value [ ` B] in [ ` E]
  | [ ` b_iszero_zero B] ⇒ [ ` v_true]
  | [ ` b_iszero_succ B] ⇒ [ ` v_false]
  | [ ` b_if_true B1 B2] ⇒ bstep_value [ ` B2]
  | [ ` b_if_false B1 B3] ⇒ bstep_value [ ` B3];

rec bstep_value_stagnate : [ ` bigstep V1 V2] → [ ` value V1] → [ ` equal V1 V2] =
  / total e (bstep_unique_stagnate _ _ _ e) /
  fn b ⇒ fn e ⇒
  case e of
  | [ ` v_zero] ⇒ let [ ` b_value _] = b in [ ` ref]
  | [ ` v_true] ⇒ let [ ` b_value _] = b in [ ` ref]
  | [ ` v_false] ⇒ let [ ` b_value _] = b in [ ` ref]
  | [ ` v_s V’] ⇒ (
      case b of
      | [ ` b_value _] ⇒ [ ` ref]
      | [ ` b_succ B’] ⇒ let [ ` ref] = bstep_value_stagnate [ ` B’] [ ` V’] in [ ` ref]
      | _ ⇒ impossible b
    );

rec bstep_to_mstep : [ ` bigstep M V] → [ ` multi_step M V] =
  / total b (bstep_to_mstep _ _ b) /
  fn b ⇒
  case b of
  | [ ` b_value _] ⇒ [ ` ms_ref]
  | [ ` b_pred_zero B] ⇒
      let [ ` S] = bstep_to_mstep [ ` B] in
      [ ` ms_tr (mstep_pred S) (ms_step e_pred_zero)]
  | [ ` b_pred_succ B] ⇒
      let [ ` S] = bstep_to_mstep [ ` B] in
      let [ ` v_succ V’] = bstep_value [ ` B] in
      [ ` ms_tr (mstep_pred S) (ms_step (e_pred_succ V’))]
  | [ ` b_succ B] ⇒
      let [ ` S] = bstep_to_mstep [ ` B] in
      mstep_succ S
  | [ ` b_iszero_zero B] ⇒
      let [ ` S] = bstep_to_mstep [ ` B] in
      [ ` ms_tr (mstep_iszero S) (ms_step e_iszero_zero)]
  | [ ` b_iszero_succ B] ⇒
      let [ ` S] = bstep_to_mstep [ ` B] in
      let [ ` v_succ V’] = bstep_value [ ` B] in
      [ ` ms_tr (mstep_iszero S) (ms_step (e_iszero_succ V’))]
  | [ ` b_if_true B1 B2] ⇒
      let [ ` S1] = bstep_to_mstep [ ` B1] in
      let [ ` S2] = bstep_to_mstep [ ` B2] in
      [ ` ms_tr (mstep_if_then_else S1 _ _) (ms_tr (ms_step e_if_true) S2)]
  | [ ` b_if_false B1 B3] ⇒
      let [ ` S1] = bstep_to_mstep [ ` B1] in
      let [ ` S3] = bstep_to_mstep [ ` B3] in
      [ ` ms_tr (mstep_if_then_else S1 _ _) (ms_tr (ms_step e_if_false) S3)];

LF equiv : term → type =
  | big_to_small : bigstep M V → multi_step M V → equiv M
  | small_to_big : halts M → bigstep M V → equiv M;

LF tp : type = 
  | b : tp 
  | arr : tp → tp → tp ;

LF tm : tp → type = 
  | app : tm (arr T S) → tm T → tm S 
  | lam : (tm T → tm S) → tm (arr T S) 
  | c : tm b ;

LF step : tm A → tm A → type = 
  | beta : step (app (lam M) N) (M N) 
  | stepapp : step M M’ → step (app M N) (app M’ N) ;

LF mstep : tm A → tm A → type = 
  | refl : mstep M M 
  | onestep : step M N → mstep N M’ → mstep M M’ ;

LF val : tm A → type = 
  | val_c : val c 
  | val_lam : val (lam M) ;

LF halts : tm A → type = 
  | halts_m : mstep M M’ → val M’ → halts M ;

stratified Reduce : {A:[ ` tp]}{M:[ ` tm A]} ctype = 
  | Rb : [ ` halts M] → Reduce [ ` b ] [ ` M] 
  | Rarr : [ ` halts M] → ({N:[ ` tm A]} Reduce [ ` A ] [ ` N] → Reduce [ ` B ] [ ` app M N]) → Reduce [ ` arr A B ] [ ` M] ;

rec halts_step : {S:[ ` step M M’]} [ ` halts M’] → [ ` halts M] = 
  mlam S ⇒ fn h ⇒ 
    let [ ` halts_m MS’ V] = h in 
    [ ` halts_m (onestep S MS’) V] ;

rec bwd_closed’ : {T:[ ` tp]}{M:[ ` tm T]}{M’:[ ` tm T]}{S:[ ` step M M’]} Reduce [ ` T] [ ` M’] → Reduce [ ` T] [ ` M] = 
  / total a (bwd_closed’ a) / 
  mlam T, M, M’ ⇒ mlam MS ⇒ fn r ⇒ 
    case [ ` T] of 
      | [ ` b] ⇒ let I ha = r in I (halts_step [ ` MS] ha) 
      | [ ` arr T S] ⇒ let Arr ha f = r in 
          Arr (halts_step [ ` MS] ha) 
              ( mlam N ⇒ fn rn ⇒ 
                  bwd_closed’ [ ` S] [ ` _ ] [ ` _ ] [ ` stepapp MS] (f [ ` N] rn)) ;

rec bwd_closed : {S:[ ` step M M’]} Reduce [ ` T] [ ` M’] → Reduce [ ` T] [ ` M] = 
  / total (bwd_closed) / 
  mlam S ⇒ fn r ⇒ 
    let [ ` S] : [ ` step M M’] = [ ` S] in 
    let [ ` M] : [ ` tm T] = [ ` M] in 
    bwd_closed’ [ ` T] [ ` M ] [ ` M’ ] [ ` S] r;

rec reduce_halts : Reduce [ ` T] [ ` M] → [ ` halts M] = 
  fn r ⇒ 
    case r of 
      | Rb h ⇒ h 
      | Rarr h f ⇒ h ;

schema ctx = tm T;

inductive Red_sub : { γ :ctx}{ σ :[ ` γ ]} ctype = 
  | Nil : Red_sub [ ] [ ` ^ ] 
  | Dot : Red_sub [ γ ] [ ` σ ] → Reduce [ ` T] [ ` M] 
         → Red_sub [ γ , x:tm T[]] [ ` σ ,M ] ;

rec lookup : { γ :ctx}{#p:[ γ ` tm T[]]}Red_sub [ γ ] [ ` σ ] → Reduce [ ` T] [ ` #p[ σ ]] = 
  mlam γ ⇒ mlam #p ⇒ fn rs ⇒ 
    case [ γ ] of 
      | [] ⇒ impossible [ ` #p] 
      | [ γ ’, x:tm T] ⇒ 
          ( case [ γ ’, x:tm T ` #p] of 
              | [ γ ’,x:tm T ` x] ⇒ 
                  let (Dot rs’ rN) = rs in 
                  rN 
              | [ γ ’,x:tm T ` #q[ ... ]] ⇒ 
                  let Dot rs’ rN = rs in 
                  lookup [ γ ’] [ γ ’ ` #q] rs’) ;

rec main: { γ :ctx}{M:[ γ ` tm T[]]} Red_sub [ γ ] [ ` σ ] → Reduce [ ` T] [ ` M[ σ ]] = 
  mlam γ ⇒ mlam M ⇒ fn rs ⇒ 
    case [ γ ` M] of 
      | [ γ ` #p] ⇒ lookup [ γ ] [ γ ` #p] rs 
      | [ γ ` lam λ x. M] ⇒ 
          Rarr [ ` halts_m refl val_lam] 
            ( mlam N ⇒ fn rN ⇒ 
                bwd_closed [ ` beta] 
                  (main [ γ ,x:tm _] [ γ ,x ` M] (Dot rs rN))) 
      | [ γ ` app M1 M2] ⇒ 
          let Rarr ha f = main [ γ ] [ γ ` M1] rs in 
          f [ ` _ ] (main [ γ ] [ γ ` M2] rs) 
      | [ γ ’ ` c] ⇒ Rb [ ` halts_m refl val_c] ;

rec weakNorm : {M:[ ` tm A]} [ ` halts M] = 
  mlam M ⇒ reduce_halts (main [] [ ` M] Nil) ;

pub type Checkpoint {
  Checkpoint(path: String, timestamp: Int, metrics: Map(String, Float))
}

pub fn save_checkpoint(path: String, data: Map(String, Dynamic)) -> Result(String, String) {
  use json_data <- result.then(json.to_string(data))
  use _ <- result.then(file.write(path, json_data))
  Ok(path)
}

pub fn load_checkpoint(path: String) -> Result(Map(String, Dynamic), String) {
  use content <- result.then(file.read(path))
  use json_data <- result.then(json.parse(content))
  Ok(json_data)
}

pub fn list_checkpoints(dir: String) -> List(Checkpoint) {
  use entries <- result.then(file.list_directory(dir))
  list.map(entries, fn(entry) {
    let full_path = string.append(dir, "/", entry)
    use stat <- result.then(file.stat(full_path))
    let timestamp = int.from_string(stat.mtime) |> result.unwrap_or(0)
    let metrics_path = string.append(full_path, "/metrics.json")
    use metrics_json <- result.then(file.read(metrics_path))
    use metrics <- result.then(json.parse(metrics_json))
    use decoded_metrics <- result.then(dynamic.decode(dynamic.dict(dynamic.float), metrics))
    Checkpoint(full_path, timestamp, decoded_metrics)
  })
  |> list.filter_map(fn(res) { case res { Ok(c) -> Ok(Some(c)) _ -> Ok(None) } })
  |> list.map(fn(opt) { opt |> result.unwrap(None) })
  |> list.filter_map(identity)
}

pub fn restore_latest(dir: String) -> Result(Checkpoint, String) {
  let checkpoints = list_checkpoints(dir)
  case list.sort(checkpoints, fn(a, b) { int.compare(a.timestamp, b.timestamp) }) {
    [] -> Error("No checkpoints found")
    [latest] -> Ok(latest)
    _ -> Error("Multiple checkpoints, use specific path")
  }
}

  use node_name <- result.then(node.start(config.nodeName))
  let rank = erlang.system_flag("smp", "enable")
  let world_size = config.workers
  let local_rank = rank % config.worker
  Ok(TrainingNode(node_name, rank, local_rank, world_size))
}

pub fn barrier(nodes: List(TrainingNode)) -> Result(Nil, String) {
  list.try_map(nodes, fn(node) {
    erlang.send(node.node, self(), "barrier")
    receive {
      [msg] if msg == "barrier_ack" -> Ok(Nil)
      _ -> Error("Barrier failed")
    }
  })
}

pub fn broadcast(nodes: List(TrainingNode), msg: Dynamic) -> Result(Nil, String) {
  list.try_map(nodes, fn(node) {
    node.node.send(node.node, msg)
    Ok(Nil)
  })
}

    erlang.send(node.node, acc, "all_reduce")
    receive {
      [node_data] -> op(acc, node_data)
      _ -> acc
    }
  })
  Ok(reduced)
}

  use _ <- result.then(barrier(nodes))
  let gradients = pgo.pmap(nodes, fn(node) {

    receive {

      _ -> dynamic.from(0.0)
    }

  use _ <- result.then(broadcast(nodes, reduced_grad))
  Ok(reduced_grad)
}

    node.node.send(node.node, "shutdown")

import qualified Data.IntMap.Strict as IM

import qualified Numeric.GSL as GSL

type Dim = 18432
type SsmState = 64
type KanGrid = 7
type SeqLen = 128000
type Batch = 1024

type SFixed = SFix

data NeuromorphicCore dom = NeuromorphicCore {
  spikeGen :: Signal dom Bit,
  synapticInt :: Matrix (SFixed dom 16 8),
  threshold :: Vec Dim (SFixed dom 16 8),
  weights :: Matrix Dim Dim (SFixed dom 16 8),
  lfsr :: Signal dom (Unsigned 32),
  output :: Signal dom (Vec Dim (SFixed dom 16 8))

neuromorphicCore :: KnownNat n => SFixed dom 16 8 -> NeuromorphicCore dom
neuromorphicCore input = NeuromorphicCore {
  spikeGen = spikeGenerator input,
  synapticInt = synapticIntegration,
  threshold = thresholds,
  weights = synapticWeights,
  lfsr = lfsrState,
  output = postSynaptic

spikeGenerator :: Signal dom (SFixed dom 16 8) -> Signal dom Bit
spikeGenerator inp = isThresholded <$> inp <*> thresholds
  where
    isThresholded x th = x > th ? (1 :: Bit, 0 :: Bit)

synapticIntegration :: Matrix (SFixed dom 16 8) Dim Dim
synapticIntegration = fromList $ replicate Dim 0.0

thresholds :: Vec Dim (SFixed dom 16 8)
thresholds = repeat (1.0 :: SFixed dom 16 8)

synapticWeights :: Matrix (SFixed dom 16 8) Dim Dim
synapticWeights = fromList $ replicate (Dim * Dim) 0.0

lfsrState :: Signal dom (Unsigned 32)
lfsrState = register 0xDEADBEEF $ lfsrStep <$> lfsrState

lfsrStep :: Unsigned 32 -> Unsigned 32
lfsrStep s = (s `shiftL` 13) xor (s `shiftR` 17) xor (s `shiftL` 5)

postSynaptic :: Signal dom (Vec Dim (SFixed dom 16 8))
postSynaptic = bundle $ map synapticUpdate [0..Dim-1]

synapticUpdate :: Int -> Signal dom (SFixed dom 16 8)
synapticUpdate i = sum $ map (weight * spike) weights
  where
    weight = synapticWeights ! (i, i)
    spike = spikeGen

data SsmCore dom = SsmCore {
  aMatrix :: Matrix (SFixed dom 16 8) SsmState SsmState,
  bInput :: Vec SsmState (SFixed dom 16 8),
  cOutput :: Vec SsmState (SFixed dom 16 8),
  state :: Reg (Vec SsmState (SFixed dom 16 8)),
  dt :: SFixed dom 16 8

ssmCore :: SsmCore dom
ssmCore = SsmCore {
  aMatrix = hippoMatrix,
  bInput = repeat 1.0,
  cOutput = repeat 1.0,
  state = reg (repeat 0.0),
  dt = 0.01

hippoMatrix :: Matrix (SFixed dom 16 8) SsmState SsmState
hippoMatrix = fromList $ L.concat [[-0.1 * fromIntegral i, 0.0] | i <- [0..SsmState-1]]

ssmStep :: Signal dom (Vec SsmState (SFixed dom 16 8)) -> Signal dom (Vec SsmState (SFixed dom 16 8))
ssmStep input = aDisc * state + b * input
  where
    aDisc = map (* exp (a * dt)) aMatrix
    b = bInput

kanSpline :: Vec Dim (SFixed dom 16 8) -> Vec KanGrid (SFixed dom 16 8)
kanSpline x = map (bspline x) knots

bspline :: SFixed dom 16 8 -> [SFixed dom 16 8] -> SFixed dom 16 8
bspline x knots = case length knots of
  1 -> knots !! 0
  n -> ((x - knots !! 0) / (knots !! (n-1) - knots !! 0)) * bspline x (init knots) + 
       ((knots !! n - x) / (knots !! n - knots !! 1)) * bspline x (tail knots)

tgnUpdate :: Matrix (SFixed dom 16 8) NodeFeat NodeFeat -> Vec TimeDim (SFixed dom 16 8) -> Matrix (SFixed dom 16 8) NodeFeat NodeFeat
tgnUpdate nodes timeEnc = nodes + timeEnc * weights

phaseAlign :: Vec Qubits (SFixed dom 16 8) -> SFixed dom 16 8 -> Vec Qubits (SFixed dom 16 8)
phaseAlign state phi = map (\s -> s * cos phi + sin phi) state

fmrnNexus :: Signal dom (Vec SeqLen (SFixed dom 16 8)) -> Signal dom (Vec SeqLen (SFixed dom 16 8))
fmrnNexus input = output
  where
    embeds = embedLorenz input
    kanOut = map kanSpline embeds
    ssmOut = map ssmStep kanOut
    tgnOut = map tgnUpdate ssmOut timeEnc

embedLorenz :: Vec SeqLen (SFixed dom 16 8) -> Vec SeqLen (SFixed dom 16 8)

lorenzEmbed :: SFixed dom 16 8 -> SFixed dom 16 8
lorenzEmbed id = sigma * (y - x) * dt where
  x,y,z = traj !! mod (id * steps, length traj)
  traj = computeLorenz sigma rho beta dt steps

    this.shape = shape;

    this.data = this.allocator.newArray(real, this.numElements());

    this.allocator.deleteArray(this.data);

    var size = 1;
    for i in this.shape do size *= i;
    return size;
  }

    forall i in this.data do i = value;
  }

        for k in 0..#A.shape[1] do

    return C;

        for (0..ndim) |i| {
            const dim_u64 = try reader.readInt(u64, .little);
            shape_buf[i] = @as(usize, @intCast(dim_u64));
        }
        const total = totalElements(shape_buf);
        var data: []f64 = undefined;
        switch (dtype) {
            .f64 => data = try allocator.alloc(f64, total),
            else => return error.UnsupportedDType,
        }
        errdefer allocator.free(data);
        for (0..total) |i| {
            const bytes = mem.asBytes(&data[i]);
            const read_count = try reader.readAll(bytes);
            if (read_count != @sizeOf(f64)) {
                allocator.free(data);
                allocator.free(shape_buf);
                return error.IncompleteRead;
            }
        }
        var strides = try allocator.alloc(usize, ndim);
        if (ndim > 0) {
            strides[ndim - 1] = 1;
            var i: usize = ndim;
            while (i > 1) {
                i -= 1;
                strides[i - 1] = strides[i] * shape_buf[i];
            }
        }
        return Tensor{
            .allocator = allocator,
            .data = data,
            .shape = shape_buf,
            .strides = strides,
            .dtype = dtype,
        };
    }

pub fn adam_update(self: *Tensor, m: *Tensor, v: *Tensor, beta1: f64, beta2: f64, lr: f64, t: usize, eps: f64, allocator: Allocator) !void {
        const total = totalElements(self.shape);
        for (0..total) |flat_idx| {
            const multi_idx = try flatToMultiIndex(flat_idx, self.shape, allocator);
            defer allocator.free(multi_idx);
            const grad_val = if (self.grad) |g| g.get(multi_idx) else 0.0;
            const m_old = m.get(multi_idx);
            const v_old = v.get(multi_idx);
            const m_new = beta1 * m_old + (1.0 - beta1) * grad_val;
            const v_new = beta2 * v_old + (1.0 - beta2) * grad_val * grad_val;
            m.set(multi_idx, m_new);
            v.set(multi_idx, v_new);
            const m_hat = m_new / (1.0 - math.pow(f64, beta1, @floatFromInt(t)));
            const v_hat = v_new / (1.0 - math.pow(f64, beta2, @floatFromInt(t)));
            const update = -lr * m_hat / (@sqrt(v_hat) + eps);
            const old_val = self.get(multi_idx);
            self.set(multi_idx, old_val + update);
        }
    }

pub fn spectral_norm(self: *const Tensor, allocator: Allocator, num_power_iters: usize) !f64 {
        if (self.shape.len != 2) return error.InvalidShape;
        const m = self.shape[0];
        const n = self.shape[1];
        var u = try Tensor.init(allocator, &.{m}, .f64);
        defer u.deinit();
        var v = try Tensor.init(allocator, &.{n}, .f64);
        defer v.deinit();
        var prng = std.rand.DefaultPrng.init(42);
        const rand = prng.random();
        for (0..m) |i| {
            u.data[i] = rand.float(f64) * 2.0 - 1.0;
        }
        var u_norm: f64 = 0.0;
        for (0..m) |i| {
            u_norm += u.data[i] * u.data[i];
        }
        u_norm = @sqrt(u_norm);
        for (0..m) |i| {
            u.data[i] /= u_norm;
        }
        for (0..num_power_iters) |_| {
            @memset(v.data, 0.0);
            for (0..n) |j| {
                for (0..m) |i| {
                    v.data[j] += self.get(&.{ i, j }) * u.data[i];
                }
            }
            var v_norm: f64 = 0.0;
            for (0..n) |j| {
                v_norm += v.data[j] * v.data[j];
            }
            v_norm = @sqrt(v_norm);
            if (v_norm > 1e-12) {
                for (0..n) |j| {
                    v.data[j] /= v_norm;
                }
            }
            @memset(u.data, 0.0);
            for (0..m) |i| {
                for (0..n) |j| {
                    u.data[i] += self.get(&.{ i, j }) * v.data[j];
                }
            }
            u_norm = 0.0;
            for (0..m) |i| {
                u_norm += u.data[i] * u.data[i];
            }
            u_norm = @sqrt(u_norm);
            if (u_norm > 1e-12) {
                for (0..m) |i| {
                    u.data[i] /= u_norm;
                }
            }
        }
        var sigma: f64 = 0.0;
        for (0..m) |i| {
            for (0..n) |j| {
                sigma += u.data[i] * self.get(&.{ i, j }) * v.data[j];
            }
        }
        return sigma;
    }

pub fn dropout(self: *const Tensor, p: f64, seed: u64, result: *Tensor) !void {
        if (!mem.eql(usize, self.shape, result.shape)) {
            return error.ShapeMismatch;
        }
        var prng = std.rand.DefaultPrng.init(seed);
        const rand = prng.random();
        const total = totalElements(self.shape);
        const scale = 1.0 / (1.0 - p);
        for (0..total) |i| {
            const val = self.data[self.offset + i];
            const drop = rand.float(f64);
            if (drop < p) {
                result.data[result.offset + i] = 0.0;
            } else {
                result.data[result.offset + i] = val * scale;
            }
        }
    }

pub fn layer_norm(self: *const Tensor, gamma: *const Tensor, beta: *const Tensor, eps: f64, result: *Tensor) !void {
        if (!mem.eql(usize, self.shape, result.shape) or !mem.eql(usize, self.shape, gamma.shape) or !mem.eql(usize, self.shape, beta.shape)) {
            return error.ShapeMismatch;
        }
        const total = totalElements(self.shape);
        var mean_val: f64 = 0.0;
        for (0..total) |i| {
            mean_val += self.data[self.offset + i];
        }
        mean_val /= @as(f64, @floatFromInt(total));
        var var_sum: f64 = 0.0;
        for (0..total) |i| {
            const val = self.data[self.offset + i];
            var_sum += (val - mean_val) * (val - mean_val);
        }
        const variance = var_sum / @as(f64, @floatFromInt(total));
        const std_dev = @sqrt(variance + eps);
        for (0..total) |i| {
            const val = self.data[self.offset + i];
            const normalized = (val - mean_val) / std_dev;
            const gamma_val = gamma.data[gamma.offset + i];
            const beta_val = beta.data[beta.offset + i];
            result.data[result.offset + i] = gamma_val * normalized + beta_val;
        }
    }

pub fn gelu(self: *const Tensor, result: *Tensor) !void {
        if (!mem.eql(usize, self.shape, result.shape)) {
            return error.ShapeMismatch;
        }
        const total = totalElements(self.shape);
        const sqrt_2_over_pi: f64 = 0.7978845608028654;
        const coeff: f64 = 0.044715;
        for (0..total) |i| {
            const x = self.data[self.offset + i];
            const tanh_arg = sqrt_2_over_pi * (x + coeff * x * x * x);
            const exp_pos = @exp(tanh_arg);
            const exp_neg = @exp(-tanh_arg);
            const tanh_val = (exp_pos - exp_neg) / (exp_pos + exp_neg);
            result.data[result.offset + i] = 0.5 * x * (1.0 + tanh_val);
        }
    }
